one_line_summary: Light and irregular listeners who use Spotify in short bursts.
primary_need: Simple value, relevant entry points and low-effort re-engagement.
primary_risk: Inactivity, churn and weak product habit.

one_line_summary: Curious listeners who explore many genres and new content.
primary_need: Discovery, variety and continuous access to fresh recommendations.
primary_risk: Recommendation fatigue or leaving when discovery quality drops.
primary_opportunity: Discovery features, new-release journeys and Premium trials.

one_line_summary: Consistent listeners who repeatedly return to preferred artists and tracks.
primary_need: Reliability, familiarity, recognition and strong retention experiences.
primary_risk: Boredom if familiar content becomes repetitive or stale.
primary_opportunity: Loyalty programs, artist updates and retention campaigns.

one_line_summary: Highly engaged listeners with frequent, long and low-friction sessions.
primary_need: Advanced personalization, uninterrupted value and premium experiences.
primary_risk: High expectations and frustration if the experience becomes inconsistent.
primary_opportunity: Premium conversion, exclusive benefits and high-value personalization.
